{{Top|leg}}
'''Operation Death-Hunter''' was a secret project developed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Jesco Comark]] to create a better [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] in secret from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Moff Comark was frustrated with the unreliability of the bounty hunters used by the Empire and their reliance on the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] and resolved to form soldiers that could act in the same capacity but with absolute loyalty. In this capacity, individuals were modified with elaborate [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] and made into [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]] with completely loyalty to the Galactic Empire. The project had its headquarters in [[the Wastes]].<ref name="DH">{{JournalCite|9|Death-Hunter}}</ref>

The first phase of the project was to kidnap [[Human/Legends|Humans]] from the ages of 15 to 25. This template was followed to ensure that the individuals would survive the transformation into a [[Death-Hunter Cyborg]]. The Humans used for the project were taken from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bescane/Legends|Bescane]], a heavily populated world that would be unlikely to follow-up on the disappearance of the individuals taken for the project. These individuals were then brought to an [[Underwater Zeta Zero Nine base|underwater base]] on [[Zeta Zero Nine]]. There, they underwent extensive and painful testing by medical droids and medical technicians to prepare them for the addition of cybernetic enhancements.<ref name="DH" />

The last phase of the project was creating specialized craft for these newly transformed cyborgs. Comark put an order into the [[Jaemus shipyards]] for modified [[Tech 4 PDV|Tech 4 Plexus Droid Vessels]] designed to carry a single individual. These craft would allow the modified cyborgs to be deployed discretely so that they could track down targets without drawing undue attention. However, only a few Death Hunter cyborgs were created before the project was sabotaged by Rebel agents led by Moff Comark's daughter, [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Amber Comark]]. The Rebels infiltrated the underwater base, freeing the prisoners. They then fled the facility, but not before firing [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] into the structure, causing the base to explode.<ref name="DH" />
